name: IPTV Player - Play HLS, M3U8 and TS Streams
description:
Play Any Stream, Right in Your Browser.

HLS Player gives you a seamless way to watch streaming content without leaving Edge. Simply paste your stream URL and enjoy high-quality playback in our clean, intuitive player interface. No more switching between apps or waiting for external players to load.

Why Choose HLS Player?
✓ Lightning-Fast Playback: Paste any HLS, DASH, or MP4 stream URL and start watching immediately
✓ Built-In Player: Enjoy your content directly in Edge with our integrated player
✓ Privacy-Focused: All data stays local - we never track what you watch or share your stream URLs
✓ Smart History: Quick access to your recent streams, stored only on your device
✓ Keyboard Shortcuts: Power-user features for faster navigation
✓ Lightweight Design: Minimal resource usage for smooth performance

Perfect For:
✓ Watching educational content streams
✓ Accessing conference live streams
✓ Playing self-hosted media content
✓ Testing stream URLs during development
✓ Viewing personal media libraries

Technical Features:
✓ Supports HLS (.m3u8), DASH (.mpd), and MP4 streams
✓ Adaptive bitrate streaming for optimal quality
✓ Customizable player settings (volume, playback speed)
✓ Remembers your preferences for each stream
✓ Multi-language support


Privacy:
HLS Player stores all data locally on your device and never sends your stream information to any servers. No trackers, no analytics, just streaming.

Ready to transform how you watch streaming content in Edge? Install HLS Player now and experience the convenience of direct, hassle-free playback!
